_note: Read-only pull config. Copy to collector/config.json, fill real addresses, keep secrets in environment variables (env:VAR). The collector never writes to these systems.

cards.node: npu-smi node name when using the fallback
cards._alt: mode 'npu-smi' + command 'npu-smi info' on the node; mode 'both' tries Prometheus then npu-smi. Fallback is automatic when Prometheus has no rows.

dify._alt: or set api_key: env:DIFY_API_KEY and login:false

deploy._alt: either poll the container platform job API, or let ops drop receipts into collector/receipts.json; drop_file wins when set
deploy._fields: order_id result instances image nodes finished_at note
